question: Can the sealed IM02 -> IM03 -> IM04/IM05 impact pipeline be run unchanged on regular seasons 2014-15 to 2022-23, and what coverage does it reach?
inputs: shufinskiy/nba_data revision e829d4678be1e075f99e5d41a1c5f97089be446b (the IM01 pin): nbastatsv3_<y> for y = 2014..2022; cdnnba_<y> for y = 2020..2022 (the pinned index has no earlier cdnnba); matchups_<y> for y = 2017..2022; shotdetail_<y> and pbpstats_<y> for y = 2014..2022
SportsDataverse player/team boxes and schedules already retained under data/raw/sportsdataverse_<y+1>/, bound to their retrieval-manifest.json hashes
Sealed 2023-24 to 2025-26 IM03 bundles (acceptance 912254343fb563c128327c53b40becada7b912191981a2a7eeda14fa900d5c4d) as earlier/later windows; never modified
method: IM02: domain/possession_repair.reconstruct_repaired_game unchanged (possession-policy-v2 rules R1-R7). Seasons without a CDN archive pass cdn_rows=None, as the current-season pipeline does; a game the single source cannot reconstruct is excluded by the policy, never guessed. The independent team-box/schedule check (IM02-R7) is applied as in the sealed audit.

IM03: domain/impact_event_repairs, impact_possessions (method v2) and impact_verification (event gate v1) unchanged; pbpstats public possession groups are compared and reviewed where available, exactly as impact_population does.

H1 schedule denominators: 1230 regular-season games for every season except 2019-20 (1059, suspended season plus 88 bubble seeding games) and 2020-21 (1080, 72-game season). The season window runs from 1 July of the starting year to 1 November of the ending year so the 2019-20 bubble is included. Play-in games are not regular-season games.
H2 a game that fails IM03 event verification is excluded and listed with its errors (the sealed seasons were iterated per game until every game passed; this backfill does not iterate).

H3 completed-season rating cutoff is the day after the season's last admitted regular-season game (IM04 caps at 1 July, which would drop the 2019-20 bubble; for every other season the two rules select the same games).
H4 pilot gate: 100 games per era (2014-15, 2017-18, 2020-21) run first; if any full season excludes more than 5% of scheduled games, stop before population and report to the owner.

IM04: evaluation/impact_ratings functions unchanged (alpha grid [10, 100, 1000], 3 game-grouped folds, seed 2501, BPR from earlier seasons only) for 1Y/2Y/3Y regular-season windows ending 2014-15 to 2022-23, plus the windows the sealed run could not form (2Y and 3Y ending 2023-24, 3Y ending 2024-25).
IM05: domain/impact_extras.game_facts unchanged with v3 rows, CDN rows where they exist, shot detail and matchups where they exist; columns whose source is missing stay unknown.
Population: each season is sealed as an ordinary append-only courtlens-impact dataset through impact_population.populate_impact_season, so WOWY, on/off and Stat Line Shift reach the new seasons.
selection: None: no outcome-driven choice. Repair and method code are the sealed versions.
uncertainty: Coverage counts are exact. Rating intervals are registered separately (courtlens-impact-intervals-v1).
evaluation: Per-season clean / patched / excluded counts with reasons and rule counters, next to the sealed three seasons
Known player-minute and box plus-minus agreement distributions (diagnostics, as IM02)
Public pbpstats possession cross-check counts and event-gate pass counts
Two independent IM02 runs reproduce the same report content hash
Runtime and peak memory per stage
acceptance: Every scheduled regular-season game is accounted for as clean, patched or excluded with a reason
Every admitted game passes the event gate; the bundle's verification gate is all true
Sealed datasets read back from PostgreSQL with matching counts; re-population reuses them
Sealed 2023-24 to 2025-26 artifacts and bundles are byte-identical before and after
outputs: data/derived/impact-history-v1/ (IM02 report, candidates, IM03 bundles, proofs, ratings, extras)
limitations: 2014-15 to 2019-20 have one event source, so cross-source arbitration is unavailable there
Defensive matchup columns are unavailable before 2017-18
2019-20 bubble and 2020-21 limited-crowd games change home advantage; IM04-method fits keep one home column as the sealed contract defines
negative_result_policy: Publish coverage and exclusions whatever they are; a season that cannot be admitted is reported, not hidden.
